title: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released **Claude Fable 5** — the first publicly available model from a new capability tier called **Mythos-class**, which sits above Opus in Anthropic's model hierarchy. Alongside it, **Claude Mythos 5** (the same underlying model with fewer safety restrictions) was made available to a small set of trusted users: cyber defenders and critical infrastructure providers.

Fable 5 is the most capable model Anthropic has ever released for general use, achieving state-of-the-art results on nearly every tested benchmark at release.

---

## Model Specs

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Model ID | `claude-fable-5` |
| Context window | 1,000,000 tokens |
| Max output tokens | 128,000 tokens |
| Thinking | Always-on adaptive thinking (budget set by model) |
| Input modalities | Text, vision |

Adaptive thinking is always enabled — unlike earlier extended-thinking configurations, the model selects its own reasoning budget based on task complexity with no explicit configuration required.

---

## Benchmark Performance

Fable 5 leads all publicly available models on agentic coding, knowledge work, and reasoning benchmarks at the time of release:

| Benchmark | Fable 5 Score | Context |
|---|---|---|
| SWE-Bench Pro | **80.3%** | 11+ points above the next-best model |
| FrontierCode Diamond | **29.3%** | Frontier-level software engineering |
| Terminal-Bench 2.1 | **88.0%** | Agentic terminal tasks |
| GDPval-AA | **1932** | Professional knowledge work |
| Spatial Reasoning | **38.6%** | Geometry, diagram understanding |
| Tool Use | **17.4%** | Planning and tool-calling accuracy |
| Legal | **13.3%** gain | Over prior SOTA |
| Health | **66.0%** | Medical knowledge |

On most benchmarks, Fable 5 scores more than 10% higher than Claude Opus 4.8.

---

## Architecture: The Mythos-Class Split

Anthropic introduced a two-model structure at this release to balance capability and safety:

- **Claude Fable 5** (general availability) — Full-capability model with silent routing applied in high-risk domains. On cybersecurity and biology queries that hit certain thresholds, the request is transparently answered by a lower-capability model instead of Fable 5.
- **Claude Mythos 5** (restricted access) — Same underlying model with the routing restrictions lifted. Available only under a separate access program for organizations with verified defensive or infrastructure use cases.

This approach lets Anthropic broadly release a frontier model while maintaining guardrails on the domains where capability itself poses risk.

---

## Key Strengths

**Agentic coding:** Fable 5's 80.3% on SWE-Bench Pro is more than 11 points clear of the next-best model at release. It handles large codebases, multi-file refactors, and long-horizon debugging tasks with substantially higher accuracy than Claude Opus 4.8.

**Knowledge work:** The GDPval-AA score of 1932 reflects strong performance across professional domains — including 13.3% improvement over prior SOTA on legal benchmarks and 66.0% on health benchmarks.

**Vision:** Improved spatial reasoning (38.6%) and document analysis relative to Claude 4.x models. Useful for tasks like architectural diagram interpretation, scientific figure analysis, and UI understanding.

**Tool use:** 17.4% on tool-use evaluation. The model shows better judgment about when to call tools versus answer from its context, reducing spurious tool invocations in agentic workflows.

---

## API Usage

```python
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-fable-5",
    max_tokens=4096,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Refactor this module to use async/await throughout."}]
)
print(message.content)
```

Fable 5 is available via the Anthropic API, Claude Code, and claude.ai. Adaptive thinking is on by default — no `thinking` block in the API request is required.

---

## Positioning vs. Claude Opus 4.8

| Dimension | Fable 5 | Opus 4.8 |
|---|---|---|
| Model ID | `claude-fable-5` | `claude-opus-4-8` |
| SWE-Bench Pro | 80.3% | ~69% |
| Context window | 1M tokens | 1M tokens |
| Thinking | Always-on adaptive | Optional extended thinking |
| Safety routing | Yes (bio/cyber domains) | No |
| Use case | Complex reasoning, frontier coding, research | Production coding, agentic tasks |

For the most demanding agentic coding, research-grade tasks, and long-horizon reasoning, Fable 5 is the recommended choice. Opus 4.8 remains a strong and cost-effective option for high-volume production workloads.
